wasteNot.description:
Waste Not yɛ nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia ho nhyehyɛe a wɔayɛ sɛ wɔde bɛkyerɛkyerɛ mpɔtam hɔfo hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔsan de fie nneɛma di dwuma sen sɛ wɔbɛtow agu wɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ.

Ɔsatu no hyɛ ɔmanfo nkuran sɛ wɔnam mpɔtam hɔ nkitahodi ahorow so nkyɛ nneɛma a wotumi de di dwuma bio anaasɛ wɔmfa mma adɔe akuw.

Hwehwɛ yɛn Beae wɔ menu no mu na hu ntoboa hokwan ahorow a ɛbɛn wo na boa ma nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma ma mpɔtam a ɛbɛkɔ so atra hɔ daa.

about.title: Fa Ho Asɛm
about.description: UK hye gu 640,000 ton reusable nneɛma afe biara. Kind Cycle, kurowfoɔ a wogyina sustainability so, rehwɛ nsɛnhyɛso a ɛboaboa nkurɔfoɔ ano ne tua gu so, na ɛma yɛde nneɛma di bio mmom sɛ yɛnkɔrecycle. Wɔwɔ nimdeɛ wɔ architecture, design ne events mu, na wɔbɔ nsɛnhyɛso a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ nkurɔfoɔ na ɛma kurom bɔ mu yie.

contact.title: Fa Yɛn Nkyerɛ
contact.description: Pɛ sɛ wuhu Kind Cycle ne Waste Not ho pii? Anaa wo pɛ sɛ wode charity anaa nsɛnhyɛso ka ho? Fa yɛn nkyerɛ!

ferrylane.description: Ferry Lane Estate yɛ beae a Waste Not campaign di kan. Wɔde nsɛnkɔm a ɛbɔ nkɔmɔ wɔ dumping beae de kyekyɛ adwene wɔ household donation ho. Hu yɛn nsɛnhyɛso a ɛkyerɛ beae ne ɛkwan a wode betumi atɔ.

haringey.description: Sɛ wode ma a, ɛyɛ mmerɛw sen sɛ wogyae. Haringey manfoɔ betumi ahu charities ne adwumakuo dodow a wɔma ntama, akonnwa, appliances ne adeɛ foforɔ agyeɛ ne gyaeɛ kwa. Dɔm so, paw adwumakuo, hu sɛnea ɛyɛ adwuma, na fa woadeɛ ma.

broadwaterfarm.description: Broadwater Farm nkurɔfo betumi ahu aban ne akyirikyiri akuw a wɔboa wɔ ntɛm so, a wɔma nsakrae ne afiri ho nneɛma sɛ ntade, mpɔtam, ne mfonini ahorow. Kɔ mu hwɛ akuw a ɛwɔ ase ha, paw deɛ wopɛ, hu sɛnea ɛyɛ, na yɛ wo afiri. Waste Not adwumayɛ no wɔ Broadwater Farm no ho sika fi Haringey Community Carbon Fund mu.

northumberlandgrove.description: Adeɛ kyɛ yɛ mmerɛ sen ɛho tow. Northumberland Grove atenaefoɔ betumi ahwɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ahoroɔ a ɛfa charity ne nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔbɔ ntɛntɛn gye nneɛma kɛseɛ ne nketenkete, ntaadeɛ, nneɛma a wɔde yɛ adwuma, ne nneɛma foforɔ a wobetumi de ama. Mia beaeɛ bi so, paw nhyehyɛeɛ bi, hwɛ sɛnea ɛyɛ adwuma, na kyɛ.

babyItems.name: Abɔfra Nneɛma
babyItems.description: Abɔfra bɔ mmerɛ, na nneɛma a wɔanya akyɛ no gye beae. To abɔfra nneɛma a wɔde yɛɛ dɛ dada ma abusua a ehia wɔn na gye beae wɔ wo fi mu.

clothes.name: Ntama
clothes.description: Pae wo ntoma adaka mu na to nea worensɔ bio. Ma w’ataade ne mpaboa nya nkwa foforɔ na obi nso mfa nsɔ.

furniture.name: Agyaadeɛ
furniture.description: Sɛ agyaadeɛ bi wɔ hɔ a worentɔso bio na ɛyɛ wo beae a, to no ma obi na ɔbɛnya anigye – wɔbɛba na wɔafa fi wo kurow abɔnten!

repair.name: Siesie No!
repair.description: Siesie nneɛma a abu yɛ ɔkwan pa a ɛbɛboa ma yɛatwa gu so a na ɛboa asase ne wo sika so.

household.name: Efie Nneɛma
household.description: Nea w’anhia no, obi beku dɛ. Efie nneɛma a woanhia bio no, ebia ɛno ara na obi rehwehwɛ!

generic.description: Sɛ wo ne afipamfo kyɛ a, ɛyɛ ɔkwan pa a wobɛfa so aboa na woakɔ so anya nkitahodi. Wubetumi de nneɛma nketenkete, dan mu nneɛma, anaa aduan mpo ama. Ɛnyɛ den sɛ afipamfo betumi akɔfa wɔn. Wubetumi de ahyɛ wo mpɔtam hɔ WhatsApp anaa Facebook kuw mu. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wokyɛ wo kuw no wɔ ha a, yɛsrɛ wo, di nkitaho!aka

ferrylane.description:
Kyɛ nea woara mpɛ bio ma wo Ferry Lane mpɔtamfoɔ: wɔwɔ abɛn nti, wɔtumi fa nneɛma no mfe. Efi nneɛma ketewa a obiara rennante kɔfa no kosi nneɛma kɛse a ne tow bɛsɛe sika, biribiara yɛ mmerɛw sɛ mpɔtamfoɔ no bɛn. Wubetumi nso de aduan a wo kɔtɔre no annya no anaa fridge mu ade a ɛda hɔ ansa na wokɔ akyirikyiri, anaa pantry mu nneɛma a ɛkɔ so ama afoforo.

Klik anaa scan QR code a ɛwɔ ase no na ka wo ho to FLAG WhatsApp community no mu na to wo nneɛma no hɔ.

whatsApp.label: Link kɔ FLAG WhatsApp community no mu

haringey.description: Nkyɛ nneɛma ma mpɔtamfoɔ yɛ ɔkwan pa a ɛma ade pa so na ɛboa ma nnipa ntam. Esiane sɛ wɔwɔ abɛn nti, mpɔtamfoɔ betumi fa nneɛma no mfeɛ — ebia ɛyɛ ade ketewa a ɛnsɛ sɛ obi kɔfa anaa ade kɛse a ne tow bɛtɔ sika. Wubetumi nso de mmoa aduan a wo pɔtee no nnɔ no, fridge mu nnommum ansa na wokɔ akyirikyiri, anaa pantry mu nneɛma kakra. Fa to wo local WhatsApp anaa Facebook group mu, anaa ka kyerɛ obi a ɔbɛn hɔ — ebia wobɛma obi anigye da.

Esiane sɛ wɔwɔ abɛn nti, mpɔtamfoɔ betumi fa nneɛma no mfeɛ — ebia ɛyɛ ade ketewa a ɛnsɛ sɛ obi kɔfa anaa ade kɛse a ne tow bɛtɔ sika. Fa to wo local WhatsApp anaa Facebook group mu, anaa ka kyerɛ obi a ɔbɛn hɔ — ebia wobɛma obi anigye da.

lloydPark.about: Lloyd Park Children's Charity ma abusuakuw ne mma wɔ Waltham Forest nkuro mu mmoa ne som.
lloydPark.howItWorks: Wɔ Baby Bank bɔ so de mma ntoma, nneɛma ne toiletries ma abusuakuw a ehia wɔn. Wɔgye abɔfra nneɛma firi mfe 0-5. Kɔ wɔn website so na to email de hwehwɛ nneɛma a wɔgye, drop-off beae ne bere.

pramDepot.about: PramDepot yɛ nsɛnhyɛso a wɔde art di dwuma na ɛboa ababaawa foforɔ a wɔyɛ mmerɛw de recycled abɔfra nneɛma ma wɔn.
pramDepot.howItWorks: To abɔfra nneɛma a wɔde yɛɛ dɛ dada wɔ Wood Green. Website no wɔ liste a ɛkyerɛ nea wɔgye. Kɔ form so na bɔ bere a wobɛde aba.

olio.about: Olio yɛ app a ɛma nkurɔfo bɔ wɔn ho ban na wɔkyɛ nneɛma kwa, na ɛboa ma yɛto gu ase.
olio.howItWorks: Download app no na yɛ account. Tɔ so na post nneɛma a wopɛ sɛ woma, te sɛ aduan ne efie nneɛma. Wubetumi ahwehwɛ so mpo na kɔgye nneɛma a nkurɔfo aka hɔ. Nkurɔfo kasa wɔn ho wɔ app no mu na yɛ pick-up anaa gyegye.

freecycle.about: Freecycle yɛ platform a nkurɔfo de nneɛma a wɔnhia bio ma kwa, na ɛma yɛde nneɛma di bio.
freecycle.howItWorks: Bɔ wo din, bɔ account, na bɛhyɛ wo kurow group ne nkurɔfo foforɔ. Wopost nneɛma a wopɛ sɛ woma, te sɛ agyaadeɛ, electronics anaa ntama. Wɔkyerɛ kwan so a wubetumi de nsɛm kɔ ma obi. Nso wubetumi post nea wopɛ nso.

facebookMarketplace.about: Facebook Marketplace yɛ platform a nkurɔfo tɔn, tɔ, anaa ma nneɛma wɔ wɔn mpɔtam.
facebookMarketplace.howItWorks: Sɛ wopɛ sɛ woma nneɛma, kɔ Marketplace so, klik "Create New Listing", paw "Item for Sale", na yɛ price £0. Fa mfonini, nkyerɛmu, beae ne nneɛma nkɔfa. Nkurɔfo beka wo ho wɔ message so.

britishHeartFoundation.about: British Heart Foundation yɛ charity a wɔhwɛ akoma yare ho adwuma ne mmoa ma wɔn a yare no afa wɔn.
britishHeartFoundation.howItWorks: Wɔgye ntama, nwoma, electronic, ne agyaadeɛ donations. Wɔde kɔfa agyaadeɛ akɛse kwa. Fill online form no na hyɛ bere, beae ne kontak.

encouragingReuse.howItWorks: "Encouraging Reuse" daakye bɔ so wɔ kurow so, na ɛde yɛn kɔ sustainability mu wɔ nneɛma a yedɔ na yɛde di bio.

traid.about: TRAID yɛ UK charity a ɛyɛ adwuma de nsakra ntama a wɔmpɛ bio na wɔde boa projects wɔ wiase nyinaa.
traid.howItWorks: Ntama a wɔde yɛɛ dɛ no wɔgye, na wɔtɔn de boa wɔn nsɛnhyɛso. Tumi de ntama brɛ donation bank anaa charity shop. Wɔgye agyaadeɛ a ɛyɛ dɛ so. Sɛ ɛyɛ bebree, wubetumi de form so bɔ collection.

weCollectWeDonate.about: WeCollectWeDonate yɛ social enterprise a wɔgye ntama, nwoma, ne efie nneɛma wɔ wo kurow abɔnten kwa.
weCollectWeDonate.howItWorks: Wɔtɔn anaa ma charities, na ɛboa ma wɔnya sika ma nsɛnhyɛso te sɛ homeless, adwene yare ne sukuu. Fa wɔn website so bɔ collection a ɛyɛ mmerɛ na wogye nneɛma pa so.

haringeyFixers.about: Haringey Fixers yɛ charity a nkurɔfo yɛ, na ɛma wɔsiesie nneɛma na wɔkyerɛ repair skills wɔ Repair Cafés.
haringeyFixers.howItWorks: Repair Café yɛ beae a nkurɔfo de nneɛma bɛsiesie. Wɔboa nkurɔfo siesie appliances, agyaadeɛ, ne ntama. Ɛkɔ so mpɛn pii wɔ Haringey, na ɛyɛ kwa. Kɔ website na hyɛ bere wɔ calendar.

northLondonWasteAuthority.about: North London Waste Authority hwɛ waste disposal ne recycling wɔ London nkurofie ason mu, na ɛma projects a ɛma yɛato gu so.
northLondonWasteAuthority.howItWorks: Wɔde repair directory wɔ website a ɛboa wɔ sɛnea wubetumi siesie wo nneɛma. Directory no yɛ nea wubetumi ahwehwɛ repair services, tips ne nkɔfa.

clothesBanks.name: Ntama Bank
clothesBanks.about: Charities te sɛ TRAID ne Salvation Army wɔ ntama bank wɔ kurow no mu a wubetumi de ntama, textiles ne mpaboa gyaw hɔ bere biara.
clothesBanks.howItWorks: Fa wo nneɛma gu bag mu na gu wɔ recycling bin. Wɔwɔ beae ahorow. Kɔ map na hu nea ɛbɛn wo.

footprintForGood.about: Footprint for Good boa mmabun a wɔwɔ ahokeka mu: wɔ nam Repair Restore Respect dwumadie no so ma wɔn a wɔka ho sua sɛnea wɔde nneɛma a ɛyɛ akyinnye bɛyɛ foforɔ ne sɛnea wɔbɛsan ayɛ ade pa, wɔnam so sa akyɛdeɛ a ɛyɛ adaka ho — ɛma wɔn nya nokwasɛm mu gyidie, adwumadie a ɛyɛ papa, na ɛbɔ so ma asetena a ɛyɛ dɛ.
footprintForGood.howItWorks: Wubetumi asrɛ sɛ wɔmfa wo adaka mfi wo fie kwa fa yɛn wɛb fom no so. Yɛn kurom adwumayɛfo bɛfrɛ wo wɔ nnawɔtwe adwuma mmerɛ anum mu abɛkyerɛ da no mu nokware. Saa som yi yɛ mpɔtam hɔ adaka nko ara. Wɔgye sofas, adaka tenten, mpokyerɛ, pon, akonnwa, mpɔtam dan na ne nsɛm ho adaka.

prayHaringey.about: Pray Haringey yɛ aban som mu ntamadan wɔ Haringey a ɔyɛ ɔmanfoɔ ho adwuma. Dwumadi bi a wɔwɔ no ne Children's Storehouse a wɔboaboa abofra 0–7 mfeɛ ho ade pa ano na wɔma abusua a wɔhia wɔ kuro no mu.
prayHaringey.howItWorks: Wobetumi de adɔeɛ no agya hɔ anaa wɔbɛba agye. Wɔgye mpomma ne mpomma nkuto, akɔnnwa, pram anaa buggy, banbɔ ɛpono, ntama, agugɔdeɛ ne nwoma a ɛfata abofra 0–7 mfeɛ.

communityClothingCollection.name: Community Clothing Collection
communityClothingCollection.about: Community Clothing Collection yɛ adwumakuo a ɛwɔ London a ɛma wɔn a wɔyɛ London ne Essex adɔeɛ ntama agyeɛ, wɔba fie na wɔgye no kwa.
communityClothingCollection.howItWorks: Paw charity a wopɛ sɛ wogyegye mu na kyerɛw wo ho din wɔ intanɛt so. Wɔbɛgye ntama ne akodeɛ a wompɛ bio wɔ wo ɛpono ano na wɔde bɛma charity a wopaw. Sɛ woreyɛ adɔeɛ no a, hwɛ adeɛ a wɔgye no ho list no.

collectMyClothes.about: Collect My Clothes yɛ UK mu som adwuma a ɛfa ntama, mpaboa, nkotoku ne akodeɛ a wompɛ bio boaboa ano na wɔtɔn de boa charities.
collectMyClothes.howItWorks: Fa ntama a wosiesie, a wobɛtumi de ayɛ bio hyɛ nkotoku mu, bisa wɔ intanɛt sɛ wɔmmra agye no na paw charity bi. Wɔde ntama no bɛsan ayɛ bio wɔ kwan pa mu na charity no nsa ka sika £200–£250 wɔ ton biara (per ton).

redonate.about: reDONATE.uk yɛ charity a ɛma ntama a wompɛ bio nya nkwa foforɔ, na ɛboa ɔmanfoɔ ne nsɛeɛ ho dɔ.
redonate.howItWorks: Bisa wɔ intanɛt sɛ wɔmmra agye wo ntama. reDONATE gye ntama pa, mpaboa, akodeɛ, abɔsoɔdeɛ, perfume ne ade foforɔ. Sɛ wode bric-a-brac ne nwoma ka ho a, wɔgye nso.

collectNDonate.about: Collect ’N Donate yɛ UK mu charity agyeɛ som. Wɔma kwa agyeɛ wɔ ɛpono ano de boa charities ahorow wɔ ɔman mu.
collectNDonate.howItWorks: Bisa agyeɛ wɔ intanɛt anaa frɛ wɔ fon so. Fa wo ntama ne akodeɛ hyɛ nkotoku a wode akyerɛw din so na gyae wɔ ɛpono ano berɛ a wɔaka. Wobetumi ama mpanyin ne abofra ntama, mpaboa a ɛyɛ pair, akodeɛ, nkotoku, abɔsoɔdeɛ, nwoma, CD/DVD ne bric-a-brac.

help2Collect.about: Help 2 Collect yɛ UK mu adɔeɛ som a ɛgye ntama pa ne akodeɛ kwa de boa charities. Wɔaboa akɔ sika £53,000 na wɔabɔ nkuto ntama pii afiri asase mu nsɛeɛ.
help2Collect.howItWorks: Bisa agyeɛ wɔ intanɛt anaa fon so. Wɔbɛgye ntama te sɛ ntama, mpaboa, nkotoku, abɔsoɔdeɛ, abofra adeɛ ne agugɔdeɛ wɔ wo ɛpono ano.

iCollectClothes.about: iCollectClothes yɛ UK mu som a ɛboa charities wɔ ntama agyeɛ wɔ ɛpono ano kwa.
iCollectClothes.howItWorks: Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wode ma a, kɔ iCollectClothes website no so, paw charity a wopɛ, na yɛ ntam na wɔmmra agye. Wobetumi de ntama, mpaboa ne akodeɛ ama.

sueRyder.about: Sue Ryder yɛ UK charity a ɛboa nnipa wɔ wɔn nkwa awiei bere ne bere a wɔrehyia ɔyera. Sika a wɔnya fi wɔn shops boa hospice ne ɔyarefoɔ a wɔwɔ adwenem ho yare mu.
sueRyder.howItWorks: Wɔma kwa furniture agyeɛ a wobetumi abisa wɔ intanɛt anaa frɛ National Furniture Line (0333 003 1883). Wɔgye sofa, akɔnnwa, adekorade, mpomma ne nsɛsoɛ electro adeɛ a ɛwɔ fire safety label.

jacksSofaDrops.about: Jacks Sofa Drops yɛ adwumakuo a wɔwɔ London ne Surrey a wɔgye sofas na akɔnnwa wɔ kwan a ɛyɛ ho mmerɛw. Adeɛ a wobetumi de ayɛ bio wɔma charities, na nea ɛrentumi nyɛ bio no, wɔsan yɛ ho adwuma ma ɛnyɛ nsɛeɛ.
jacksSofaDrops.howItWorks: Bisa agyeɛ wɔ wɔn intanɛt form, na wɔbɛka akyire abɛyɛ ntam wɔ 24 anadwo mu. Wɔgye sofas, akɔnnwa kɛseɛ ne dining table a wɔde yɛɛ dadeɛ kakra kwa.

freegle.about: Freegle yɛ UK community platform a ɛma nnipa tumi de adeɛ ma kwa anaa gye adeɛ ma kwa. Ɛboa reuse na ɛma nsɛeɛ tɔ kɔ.
freegle.howItWorks: Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wode adeɛ ma a, kɔ Freegle group wɔ intanɛt, kyerɛ adeɛ a wopɛ sɛ wode ma, na yɛ ntam ne ɔbarima/ɔbaa a ɔpɛ adeɛ no.

loveJunk.about: LoveJunk yɛ marketplace a ɛma nnipa kɔ nsam waste collectors a wɔwɔ license ne adwumakuo a wɔsan yɛ adeɛ bio, ma ɛyɛ kwa na ɛyɛ ho mmerɛw.
loveJunk.howItWorks: Nnipa betumi de photo ne nsɛm tiaa hyɛ LoveJunk kwa. Waste collectors a wɔwɔ license ne adwumakuo a wɔsan yɛ adeɛ bio bɛhwɛ, wɔbɛma nsam anaa wɔbɛgye adeɛ kwa sɛ ɛyɛ deɛ wobetumi de ayɛ bio.
